title: Document
主要内容: On March 13, 2020, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. completed its acquisition of Tekra, LLC and Trient, LLC, converters of high-performance films and substrates. The acquisition is referenced in the Form 8-K filing. SWM operates globally, with operations on four continents and presence in over 90 countries. The move aims to strengthen SWM's position in the high-performance films and substrates market by expanding its conversion capabilities. The document outlines key risks affecting the company's operations, including market and industry fluctuations, rising commodity prices, supply shortages, adverse changes in key customer sectors, inflation, labor expenses, regulatory changes, labor strikes, tariffs, trade barriers, regulatory enforcement, economic conditions, changes in LIBOR rates, restructuring initiatives, supplier failures, and international conflicts.
